programme.title: Bizarre food: culinary trips / Skurrile Kost: Kulinarische Reisen
programme.desc: It doesn't always have to be bizarre and unusual, that is the motto of this `everything-eating spin-offs with Andrew Zimmer. Instead, this time he can be spoiled with culinary costings from the hottest cities in the world. / Es muss nicht immer skurril und ungewohnlich sein, das ist das Motto dieses `Alles-Esser-Spin-Offs mit Andrew Zimmern. Stattdessen lasst er sich diesmal mit kulinarischen Kostlichkeiten aus den angesagtesten Metropolen der Welt verwohnen.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.desc: The criminal officer Adrian Monk quickly became a little bit of a small body due to his special facilities in his profession. He has a photographic memory and can make a track even from the smallest indications. Since the death of his beloved wife Trudy due to a mysterious attack, however, he has suffered from strong fears and obsessive -he -forcendants, which leads to his suspension from service at the San Fransisco Police Department. After he has locked himself up in his apartment for three years, he finally becomes a self -timed as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming Lost Monk, the crime trap that nobody else can loose. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to drive a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police service. From then on he is investigating with Commissioner Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: Smart10 - the quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Two teams of two compete against each other in the knowledge duel at Caroline Athanasiadis. The participants have to demonstrate general knowledge, good teamwork, tactics and risk giving away in order to successfully cut off. / Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 A note is wrong / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First the topic of the term searched is announced. With the help of four notes, the candidates should get on the right track - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. Zuerst wird das Thema des gesuchten Begriffes bekannt gegeben. Mithilfe von vier Hinweisen sollen die Kandidaten auf die richtige Spur kommen - doch nur drei davon sind richtig.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the "Jager". This is not an easy task, because the "Jagers" are proven quiz professionals from the German quiz national team, including even the German quizmaster. In the first round, the candidates set up a game sum individually, which they have to defend together against the "Jager" in the second round to move into the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the "Jager" and defend the money earned so far. You have to answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions than the "Jager", they won. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise / Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A cruel violent crime is done on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. In order to clear it up, the London investigator Richard Poole is put on the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but at all it cannot make friends with the Caribbean mentality. This always ensures entertaining situations. The meticulous suit runner succeeds in loosening the case together with his colleagues on site. They absolutely want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like the sea fruit. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.desc: The Tyrolean Unterland with its outstanding sporting and tourist offers is the scene of the police team around criminal officer Karin Kofler and her colleague Lukas Roither, which specializes in criminal psychology, who, with a lot of expertise and empathy, put the craft from the local criminals. And finally there is Grafin Schonberg, who, with her contacts to the Kitzbuheler JetSet, proves again and again as valuable help for the officials. / Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Съставът на Германия, който загуби финала преди 3 години след продължения, е рекордьор по европейски победи, като е триумфирал 8 пъти в досегашните 13 издания, но последната им титла е от 2013 г. programme.title: Woody Allen Panorama: Bullets over Broadway / Панорама на Уди Алън: Куршуми над Бродуей
programme.desc: Dry regime in the United States. The Mafia Vilinee. Nick Valenty is a mafia boss. His mistress Oliva Neal dances in the variety, but I dream of becoming an actress. David Shane is a playwright, with a few failed plays, but has now written a new play. The director of the theater Julian Marx likes the play, but cannot afford to put it for financial reasons. Marx meets valence at one reception and they both agree - Nick will finance the play on condition that they give a role to his mistress, Oliva. David agrees. He will direct the play. The main role is played by a post -star star, Helen Sinkler. Oliva give the role of the psychiatrist. Valenti attaches to her one of her gorillas - Chicch. Rehearsals begin, Oliva is a terribly bad actress. The play needs processing. Most unexpectedly, Chicch is an exceptional playwright and gradually the play becomes his business. The production has been a huge success, David falls in love with Helen and plans to abandon his girlfriend Ellen. Chiich is so annoyed by Oliv's bad game that he shoots her so he doesn't fail his play. However, Valenti remembers and sends him to kill him. The last words of Chicch are to improve the play. David realizes that he has not talent enough and that he loves Ellen and they both return to Pittsburgh ... / Сухият режим във САЩ. Мафията вилинее. Ник Валенти е мафиотски бос. Любовницата му Олив Нийл танцува във вариете, но мечтая да стане актриса. Дейвид Шейн е драматург, с няколко провалени пиеси, но сега е написал нова пиеса. Директорът на театъра Джулиън Маркс харесва пиесата, но не може да си позволи да я постави от финансови съображения. Маркс среща Валенти на един прием и двамата се споразумяват - Ник ще финасира пиесата при условие, че дадат роля на любовницата му, Олив. Дейвид се съгласява. Той ще режисира пиесата. За главната роля ангажират една позазалязла звезда - Хелън Синклер. На Олив дават ролята на психиатърката. Валенти прикрепя към нея една от горилите си - Чийч. Репетициите започват, Олив е ужасно лоша актриса. Пиесата има нужда от преработка. Най-неочаквано Чийч се оказва изключителен драматург и постепенно пиесата става негово дело. Постановката има огромен успех, Дейвид се влюбва в Хелън и смята да изостави приятелката си Елън. Чийч дотолкова се дразни от лошата игра на Олив, че я застрелва, за да не му проваля пиесата. Валенти обаче се досеща и праща да го убият. Последните думи на Чийч са за подобряване на пиесата. Дейвид разбира, че няма достатъчно талант и че обича Елън и двамата се връщат в Питсбърг...

Chiich is so annoyed by Oliv's bad game that he shoots her so he doesn't fail his play. However, Valenti remembers and sends him to kill him. The last words of Chicch are to improve the play. David realizes that he has not talent enough and that he loves Ellen and they both return to Pittsburgh ... / Сухият режим във САЩ. Мафията вилинее. Ник Валенти е мафиотски бос. Любовницата му Олив Нийл танцува във вариете, но мечтая да стане актриса. Дейвид Шейн е драматург, с няколко провалени пиеси, но сега е написал нова пиеса. Директорът на театъра Джулиън Маркс харесва пиесата, но не може да си позволи да я постави от финансови съображения. Маркс среща Валенти на един прием и двамата се споразумяват - Ник ще финасира пиесата при условие, че дадат роля на любовницата му, Олив. Дейвид се съгласява. Той ще режисира пиесата. За главната роля ангажират една позазалязла звезда - Хелън Синклер. На Олив дават ролята на психиатърката. Валенти прикрепя към нея една от горилите си - Чийч. Репетициите започват, Олив е ужасно лоша актриса. Пиесата има нужда от преработка. Най-неочаквано Чийч се оказва изключителен драматург и постепенно пиесата става негово дело. Постановката има огромен успех, Дейвид се влюбва в Хелън и смята да изостави приятелката си Елън. Чийч дотолкова се дразни от лошата игра на Олив, че я застрелва, за да не му проваля пиесата. Валенти обаче се досеща и праща да го убият. Последните думи на Чийч са за подобряване на пиесата. Дейвид разбира, че няма достатъчно талант и че обича Елън и двамата се връщат в Питсбърг...

programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

Program, Germany, 2025) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cup dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come by the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka, 2025) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.title: Barcelona - Inter, Football, Champions League / Barcelona - Inter, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a champion Cup was established, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Frankfurt - Tottenham, Football, Europa League / Frankfurt - Tottenham, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Panorama / Panorama
programme.sub-title: Zeit zu gehen? - Deutschland, Syrien und Ich
programme.desc: Is it time to go? A highly up -to -date question for German -Syrian journalists Sulaiman Tadmory - in a double relationship. On the one hand, because she was unthinkable for many from Syria to the fall of the Syrian dictator Assad, but also because the criticism of migration and asylum in Germany has increased massively. After his arrival in Germany, Sulaiman Tadmory - now German State Burger, like many former Syrian, is on a personal journey to find out in Germany Has a future and whether it could exist in Syria. So: Is there a place for him between growing racism and radicals after "remigration"? Does "his" Syria still exist after almost 15 years of war? Sulaiman Tadmory, today a reporter at "Panorama" (ARD) and "Ctrl F" (funk), not only travels to its old homeland, the Syrian city of Homs, but meets with different Syrians in Germany, who have different perspectives and answers to this question. He speaks to Mohammed, a metal builder who has decided to finally go back to Syria as part of the Federal Government's voluntary return program. His decision has been driven by the desire to be able to be back with his family and to rebuild the war -plagued land with his newly acquired knowledge. Leeen, a young woman who lives in Berlin together with her mother, an Alawitin, states that, despite all the political tensions and challenges, Germany is the more secure place for both of her. You can see your future here because you believe that the country offers a great freedom and security as Syria under an Islamist government. Another conversation runs Sulaiman Tadmory with Maher, a doctor in the Munsterland who, together with his German fiance - is going to "plan B" - an emergency plan for the moment if the AfD in Germany should come to power. The examination of this possible scenario shows the uncertainty and fears that many members of the Syrian community in Germany are increasingly concerned. Is home in Germany possible? And if so: under what conditions? Questions that affect all people apart from Sulaiman Tadmory, not just with Syrian migration history. Questions he asks in interviews to politicians who are currently determining the debate and make the decisions. "Time to go?" Is a film that goes far beyond the individual fate: How much home is still possible in a Germany that apparently pays more deportations and a tough asylum policy to his most important tasks? / Ist es Zeit zu gehen? Fur den deutsch-syrischen Journalisten Sulaiman Tadmory eine hochaktuelle Frage - in doppelter Beziehung. Einerseits, weil sie fur viele aus Syrien Gefluchtete bis zum Sturz des syrischen Diktators Assad undenkbar war, aber andererseits auch, weil die Kritik an Migration und Asyl in Deutschland massiv zugenommen hat.Zehn Jahre nach seiner Ankunft in Deutschland begibt sich Sulaiman Tadmory - inzwischen deutscher Staatsburger wie viele ehemalige syrische Gefluchtete - auf eine personliche Reise, um herauszufinden, ob er in Deutschland noch eine Zukunft hat und ob es sie in Syrien geben konnte. Also: Gibt es fur ihn hier zwischen wachsendem Rassismus und radikalen Rufen nach "Remigration" noch einen Platz? Existiert "sein" Syrien nach knapp 15 Jahren Krieg uberhaupt noch?Sulaiman Tadmory, heute Reporter bei "Panorama" (ARD) und "STRG F" (funk), reist fur die 30-minutige Dokumentation nicht nur zuruck in seine alte Heimat, die syrische Stadt Homs, sondern trifft sich mit verschiedenen Syrerinnen und Syrern in Deutschland, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Antworten auf diese Frage haben. Er spricht mit Mohammed, einem Metallbauer, der beschlossen hat, im Rahmen des freiwilligen Ruckkehrprogramms der Bundesregierung endgultig wieder nach Syrien zu gehen. Seine Entscheidung ist getrieben von dem Wunsch, wieder bei seiner Familie sein zu konnen und das kriegsgeplagte Land mit seinen neu erworbenen Kenntnissen wieder aufzubauen.Leen, eine junge Frau, die zusammen mit ihrer Mutter, einer Alawitin, in Berlin lebt, steht dagegen fur die Überzeugung, dass Deutschland trotz aller politischen Spannungen und Herausforderungen der sicherere Ort fur sie beide ist. Sie sehen hier ihre Zukunft, da sie glauben, dass das Land eine groSSere Freiheit und Sicherheit biete als Syrien unter einer islamistischen Regierung.Ein weiteres Gesprach fuhrt Sulaiman Tadmory mit Maher, einem Arzt im Munsterland, der gemeinsam mit seiner deutschen Verlobten einen "Plan B" entwickelt - einen Notfallplan fur den Moment, falls die AfD in Deutschland an die Macht kommen sollte. Die Auseinandersetzung mit diesem moglichen Szenario zeigt die Unsicherheit und die Ängste, die viele Angehorige der syrischen Gemeinschaft in Deutschland zunehmend umtreiben.Ist Heimat in Deutschland moglich? programme.sub-title: Zeit zu gehen? - Deutschland, Syrien und Ich
programme.desc: Is it time to go? A highly up -to -date question for German -Syrian journalists Sulaiman Tadmory - in a double relationship. On the one hand, because she was unthinkable for many from Syria to the fall of the Syrian dictator Assad, but also because the criticism of migration and asylum in Germany has increased massively. After his arrival in Germany, Sulaiman Tadmory - now German State Burger, like many former Syrian, is on a personal journey to find out in Germany Has a future and whether it could exist in Syria. So: Is there a place for him between growing racism and radicals after "remigration"? Does "his" Syria still exist after almost 15 years of war? Sulaiman Tadmory, today a reporter at "Panorama" (ARD) and "Ctrl F" (funk), not only travels to its old homeland, the Syrian city of Homs, but meets with different Syrians in Germany, who have different perspectives and answers to this question. He speaks to Mohammed, a metal builder who has decided to finally go back to Syria as part of the Federal Government's voluntary return program. His decision has been driven by the desire to be able to be back with his family and to rebuild the war -plagued land with his newly acquired knowledge. Leeen, a young woman who lives in Berlin together with her mother, an Alawitin, states that, despite all the political tensions and challenges, Germany is the more secure place for both of her. You can see your future here because you believe that the country offers a great freedom and security as Syria under an Islamist government. Another conversation runs Sulaiman Tadmory with Maher, a doctor in the Munsterland who, together with his German fiance - is going to "plan B" - an emergency plan for the moment if the AfD in Germany should come to power. The examination of this possible scenario shows the uncertainty and fears that many members of the Syrian community in Germany are increasingly concerned. Is home in Germany possible? And if so: under what conditions? Questions that affect all people apart from Sulaiman Tadmory, not just with Syrian migration history. Questions he asks in interviews to politicians who are currently determining the debate and make the decisions. "Time to go?" Is a film that goes far beyond the individual fate: How much home is still possible in a Germany that apparently pays more deportations and a tough asylum policy to his most important tasks? / Ist es Zeit zu gehen? Fur den deutsch-syrischen Journalisten Sulaiman Tadmory eine hochaktuelle Frage - in doppelter Beziehung. Einerseits, weil sie fur viele aus Syrien Gefluchtete bis zum Sturz des syrischen Diktators Assad undenkbar war, aber andererseits auch, weil die Kritik an Migration und Asyl in Deutschland massiv zugenommen hat.Zehn Jahre nach seiner Ankunft in Deutschland begibt sich Sulaiman Tadmory - inzwischen deutscher Staatsburger wie viele ehemalige syrische Gefluchtete - auf eine personliche Reise, um herauszufinden, ob er in Deutschland noch eine Zukunft hat und ob es sie in Syrien geben konnte. Also: Gibt es fur ihn hier zwischen wachsendem Rassismus und radikalen Rufen nach "Remigration" noch einen Platz? Existiert "sein" Syrien nach knapp 15 Jahren Krieg uberhaupt noch?Sulaiman Tadmory, heute Reporter bei "Panorama" (ARD) und "STRG F" (funk), reist fur die 30-minutige Dokumentation nicht nur zuruck in seine alte Heimat, die syrische Stadt Homs, sondern trifft sich mit verschiedenen Syrerinnen und Syrern in Deutschland, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Antworten auf diese Frage haben. Er spricht mit Mohammed, einem Metallbauer, der beschlossen hat, im Rahmen des freiwilligen Ruckkehrprogramms der Bundesregierung endgultig wieder nach Syrien zu gehen. Seine Entscheidung ist getrieben von dem Wunsch, wieder bei seiner Familie sein zu konnen und das kriegsgeplagte Land mit seinen neu erworbenen Kenntnissen wieder aufzubauen.Leen, eine junge Frau, die zusammen mit ihrer Mutter, einer Alawitin, in Berlin lebt, steht dagegen fur die Überzeugung, dass Deutschland trotz aller politischen Spannungen und Herausforderungen der sicherere Ort fur sie beide ist. Sie sehen hier ihre Zukunft, da sie glauben, dass das Land eine groSSere Freiheit und Sicherheit biete als Syrien unter einer islamistischen Regierung.Ein weiteres Gesprach fuhrt Sulaiman Tadmory mit Maher, einem Arzt im Munsterland, der gemeinsam mit seiner deutschen Verlobten einen "Plan B" entwickelt - einen Notfallplan fur den Moment, falls die AfD in Deutschland an die Macht kommen sollte. Die Auseinandersetzung mit diesem moglichen Szenario zeigt die Unsicherheit und die Ängste, die viele Angehorige der syrischen Gemeinschaft in Deutschland zunehmend umtreiben.Ist Heimat in Deutschland moglich? Und falls ja: unter welchen Bedingungen? Fragen, die auSSer Sulaiman Tadmory alle Menschen betreffen, nicht nur mit syrischer Migrationsgeschichte. programme.title: Dream Weekend in Prague with Sasa Schwarzjirg / Traumweekend in Prag mit Sasa Schwarzjirg
programme.desc: Prague, the capital of the Czech Republic, attracts millions of tourists annually. Sasa Schwarzjirg goes on historical and cultural traces of the city. Prague as a university city attracts a lot of young audiences, the Karlsbrucke with the numerous figures, the Prague castle and the apostle watch are the most popular photo motifs in the city. Prague is also a city of pleasure. There are 30 breweries here, some of which are hearty, and the tree cake is ideal as a dessert. The story of why the Czech Suuss dish does not actually come from the Czech Republic learns Sasa on her stroll through her, which also runs over the many flea markets and stands along the Vltava. / Prag, die Hauptstadt von Tschechien, lockt jahrlich Millionen von Touristen an. Sasa Schwarzjirg begibt sich auf historische und kulturelle Spuren der Stadt. Prag als Universitatsstadt zieht viel junges Publikum an, die Karlsbrucke mit den zahlreichen Figuren, die Prager Burg und die Aposteluhr sind die beliebtesten Fotomotive der Stadt. Prag ist aber auch eine Genussstadt. Allein 30 Brauereien gibt es hier, dazu teils deftiges Essen, und als Nachspeise bietet sich der Baumkuchen an. Die Geschichte, warum die tschechische SuSSspeise eigentlich gar nicht aus Tschechien kommt, erfahrt Sasa bei ihrem Stadtbummel, der sie auch uber die vielen Flohmarkte und Stande entlang der Moldau fuhrt.

With the eye of the Koralbahn, Karnten is growing together with Styria as the second -sized economic area in Austria. This documentation should show how Karnten can use it for the advantages and disadvantages for the companies and for employees. / Thema ist die Entwicklung der Wirtschaft im sudlichsten Bundesland Österreichs vom Beginn des Bergbaus in der Romerzeit uber die Grundung der ersten Gewerke und Industriebetriebe bis herauf in das 21. Jahrhundert, das vor allem einen rasanten Ausbau der Technologiebetriebe - Stichwort Infineon - gebracht hat. Mit der Eroffnung der Koralmbahn wachst Karnten mit der Steiermark zum zweitgroSSten Wirtschaftsraum in Österreich zusammen. Wie Karnten das fur sich nutzen kann, welche Vor-und Nachteile das fur die Unternehmen und fur die Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bringt, soll diese Dokumentation aufzeigen.

programme.title: Endless trauma - 80 years of Hiroshima / Trauma ohne Ende - 80 Jahre Hiroshima
programme.desc: The first and so far only atomic bombing in human history years for the 80th time. On August 6th and 9th, 1945, the United States attacked the Japanese city of Hiroshima and Nagasaki with atomic bombs, 100,000 people were immediately died in the explosions and the fire storm, another 130,000 people died of the consequences in the same year. For the World Journal, she visited the scene of the first atomic bombing and spoke to one of the few remaining survivors and descendants of atomic bomb victims. How do young generations deal with the traumatic heritage? How does the horror work into the third and fourth generation after? Design: Judith Brandner / Die ersten und bisher einzigen Atombombenabwurfe in der Menschheitsgeschichte jahren sich heuer zum 80. Mal. Am 6. und 9. August 1945 griffen die USA die japanischen Stadte Hiroshima und Nagasaki mit Atombomben an, bei den Explosionen und dem Feuersturm wurden 100.000 Menschen sofort getotet, weitere 130.000 Menschen starben noch im gleichen Jahr an den Folgeschaden.ORF-Japan-Expertin Judith Brandner berichtet seit vielen Jahren in TV- und Radiosendungen, Buchern und Artikeln uber Japan. Fur das WELTjournal hat sie den Schauplatz des ersten Atombombenabwurfs nochmals besucht und mit einem der wenigen verbliebenen Überlebenden und mit Nachkommen von Atombombenopfern gesprochen. Wie gehen jungere Generationen mit dem traumatischen Erbe um? Wie wirkt das Grauen in die dritte und vierte Generation nach?Gestaltung: Judith Brandner

At the scene of Reporter Nicole Kampl, Lignano shows while Pentecost and away from Pentecost and explores the question of why so many Austrians in the seaside resort every year. / Fur viele Österreicherinnen und Österreicher ist es ein Ritual: Einmal im Jahr nach Lignano fahren. programme.title: Eco special / Eco Spezial
programme.desc: Many people in Austria believe that they do not eat genetic engineering - especially if they use products that are marked as "organic" or "genetic engineering free". But that is not true: For decades, seeds have been changed using old genetic engineering methods - for example through radioactive radiation or chemical treatment, which even happens directly in Austria, for example in Seibersdorf near Vienna. According to the European Court of Justice, this method is considered a genetic engineering, but does not have to be marked. The reason: it can no longer be detected in the products and is considered safe. The plants that emerge from it are impossible to distinguish from nature breeded. Nevertheless, the EU Commission's proposal ensures that this new form of plant breeding for genetic engineering for genetic engineering, for horror for organic farmers, seeds and NGOs such as Greenpeace. The decision is still open - there is currently no clear majority in the EU. / Viele Menschen in Österreich glauben, keine Gentechnik zu essen - vor allem wenn sie zu Produkten greifen, die als "Bio" oder "gentechnikfrei" gekennzeichnet sind. Doch das stimmt so nicht: Seit Jahrzehnten wird Saatgut mithilfe alter Gentechnikverfahren verandert - etwa durch radioaktive Bestrahlung oder chemische Behandlung.Das passiert sogar direkt in Österreich, zum Beispiel in Seibersdorf bei Wien. Diese Methode gilt zwar laut Europaischem Gerichtshof als Gentechnik, muss aber nicht gekennzeichnet werden. Der Grund: Sie lasst sich in den Produkten nicht mehr nachweisen und gilt als sicher.Die neue Zuchtungsmethode CRISPR - die "Genschere" - ist ein viel kleinerer Eingriff in das Erbgut. Die Pflanzen, die aus ihr hervorgehen, sind unmoglich von naturnah gezuchteten Arten zu unterscheiden. Dennoch sorgt der Vorschlag der EU-Kommission, diese neue Form der Pflanzenzuchtung von den strengen Auflagen fur Gentechnik zu befreien, fur Schrecken bei Biobauern, Saatgutzuchtern und NGOs wie Greenpeace.Die Entscheidung ist noch offen - in der EU gibt es dazu derzeit keine klare Mehrheit.

At "Stöckl" experience meets new, find big topics of our time and the private events of the guest together. To a guest at Barbara Stockl:* Conny Kreuter, Profit dance* Eva Maria Klinger, journalist and moderator* Matthias Bartolomey, Cellist* Arnold Mettnitzer, theologian and psychotherapist / Die Moderatorin Barbara Stockl steht fur Kompetenz, Glaubwurdigkeit, Offenheit und Neugier. Bei "STÖCKL" trifft Erfahrung auf Neues, finden groSSe Themen unserer Zeit und die privaten Ereignisse der Gaste zu einem interessanten Ganzen zusammen.Zu Gast bei Barbara Stockl:* Conny Kreuter, Profitanzerin* Eva Maria Klinger, Journalistin and Moderatorin* Matthias Bartolomey, Cellist* Arnold Mettnitzer, Theologe, Seelsorger and Psychotherapeut

programme.title: Lagorai - mountains between loneliness and cultural diversity / Lagorai - Berge zwischen Einsamkeit und kultureller Vielfalt
programme.desc: The Lagorai chain is one of the few natural landscapes in Trentino, which is hardly developed by tourism. There are exciting encounters with people who defy the rough nature on remote alpine pastures and crystal -clear mountain lakes. The designer of the documentary, Martina Juda, wanders over long distances on remote paths with cameraman Manfred Unterpertinger into the silence and loneliness of these mountains between Val Die Fiemme, the fleet valley in the north and the Valsugana in Suden. / Die Lagorai-Kette ist eine der wenigen, vom Tourismus kaum erschlossenen Naturlandschaften im Trentino. Auf abgelegene Almen und an glasklaren Bergseen kommt es zu spannenden Begegnungen mit Menschen, die der rauen Natur trotzen.In verschlafenen Bergdorfern am FuSSe der fast 3000 m hohen Gipfel ist altes Brauchtum bewahrt geblieben. Über weite Strecken auf abgelegenen Pfaden wandert die Gestalterin der Dokumentation, Martina Juda, mit dem Kameramann Manfred Unterpertinger in die Stille und Einsamkeit dieser Berge zwischen dem Val die Fiemme, dem Fleimstal im Norden und der Valsugana im Suden.

programme.title: Experience Austria / Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Das Frankenburger Wurfelspiel oder das Blutgericht vor dem Hausamer Feld
programme.desc: From 1525 to 1625, large parts of today's Oberosterreich were Protestant. After the outbreak of the Thirty Year of War in 1618, Duke Maximilian I of Bavaria used Adam Graf Herberstorff converted to Catholicism as governor for Oberosterreich. With hard he implemented the principle of the "Cuius Regio, Eius Religio", so he was able to give his subjects to the Roman-Catholic faith as the sovereign. When a Catholic priest moved into a Protestant rectory in Frankenburg am Hausruck on the house ruck, the turmoil occurred. After its suppression, Herberstorff quoted all man's residents of the county on May 15, 1625 on the Haushamerfeld. The 36 men who were identified as a cyclist and sentenced to death had to worry about their lives. The winner was released, the loser is going on the spot. The blood court on Haushamer Feld went into history as the cruel Frankenburg Wurf game and is considered the start of the Upper Easter Rich Peasant War. The Austria experience of the ORF Oberosterreich is devoted to this greatest Easter -Reiche historical game, which is performed every two years as a Volksstuck "Frankenburg Wurf Play" with around 700 amateur actors in Frankenburg am Hausruck. / Von 1525 bis 1625 waren weite Teile des heutigen Oberosterreichs protestantisch. Nach Ausbruch des DreiSSigjahrigen Krieges 1618 setzte Herzog Maximilian I. von Bayern den zum Katholizismus konvertierten Adam Graf Herberstorff als Statthalter fur Oberosterreich ein. Mit Harte setzte dieser das Prinzip des "Cuius regio, eius religio" um, also er durfte damit als Landesherr seinen Untertanen den romisch-katholischen Glauben vorgeben. Als 1625 in Frankenburg am Hausruck ein katholischer Geistlicher ein protestantisches Pfarrhaus bezog, kam es zum Aufruhr. Nach dessen Niederschlagung zitierte Herberstorff am 15. Mai 1625 alle mannlichen Bewohner der Grafschaft auf das Haushamerfeld. Die 36 Manner, die als Radelsfuhrer identifiziert und zum Tode verurteilt wurden, mussten um ihr Leben wurfeln. Der Gewinner wurde frei, der Verlierer an Ort und Stelle gehenkt.Das Blutgericht am Haushamer Feld ging als das grausame Frankenburger Wurfelspiel in die Geschichte ein und gilt als Auftakt zum oberosterreichischen Bauernkrieg. Das ERLEBNIS ÖSTERREICH des ORF Oberosterreich widmet sich diesem groSSten osterreichische Historienspiels, das zum Gedenken alle zwei Jahre als Volksstuck "Frankenburger Wurfelspiel" mit rund 700 Laienschauspielern in Frankenburg am Hausruck aufgefuhrt wird.

programme.title: Austria picture from the State Studio Karnten / Österreich-Bild aus dem Landesstudio Karnten
programme.sub-title: Mit Rad und Zug durch den Alpen Adria Raum
programme.desc: What is there more beautiful than swinging on the bike on a sunny and warm day and treading in the pedals to enjoy the beauties of the landscape. August 1945 griffen die USA die japanischen Stadte Hiroshima und Nagasaki mit Atombomben an, bei den Explosionen und dem Feuersturm wurden 100.000 Menschen sofort getotet, weitere 130.000 Menschen starben noch im gleichen Jahr an den Folgeschaden.ORF-Japan-Expertin Judith Brandner berichtet seit vielen Jahren in TV- und Radiosendungen, Buchern und Artikeln uber Japan. programme.desc: Many people in Austria believe that they do not eat genetic engineering - especially if they use products that are marked as "organic" or "genetic engineering free". programme.title: Experience Austria / Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Das Frankenburger Wurfelspiel oder das Blutgericht vor dem Hausamer Feld
programme.desc: From 1525 to 1625, large parts of today's Oberosterreich were Protestant. After the outbreak of the Thirty Year of War in 1618, Duke Maximilian I of Bavaria used Adam Graf Herberstorff converted to Catholicism as governor for Oberosterreich. With hard he implemented the principle of the "Cuius Regio, Eius Religio", so he was able to give his subjects to the Roman-Catholic faith as the sovereign. When a Catholic priest moved into a Protestant rectory in Frankenburg am Hausruck on the house ruck, the turmoil occurred. After its suppression, Herberstorff quoted all man's residents of the county on May 15, 1625 on the Haushamerfeld. The 36 men who were identified as a cyclist and sentenced to death had to worry about their lives. The winner was released, the loser is going on the spot. The blood court on Haushamer Feld went into history as the cruel Frankenburg Wurf game and is considered the start of the Upper Easter Rich Peasant War. The Austria experience of the ORF Oberosterreich is devoted to this greatest Easter -Reiche historical game, which is performed every two years as a Volksstuck "Frankenburg Wurf Play" with around 700 amateur actors in Frankenburg am Hausruck. / Von 1525 bis 1625 waren weite Teile des heutigen Oberosterreichs protestantisch. Nach Ausbruch des DreiSSigjahrigen Krieges 1618 setzte Herzog Maximilian I. von Bayern den zum Katholizismus konvertierten Adam Graf Herberstorff als Statthalter fur Oberosterreich ein. Mit Harte setzte dieser das Prinzip des "Cuius regio, eius religio" um, also er durfte damit als Landesherr seinen Untertanen den romisch-katholischen Glauben vorgeben. Als 1625 in Frankenburg am Hausruck ein katholischer Geistlicher ein protestantisches Pfarrhaus bezog, kam es zum Aufruhr. Nach dessen Niederschlagung zitierte Herberstorff am 15. Mai 1625 alle mannlichen Bewohner der Grafschaft auf das Haushamerfeld. Die 36 Manner, die als Radelsfuhrer identifiziert und zum Tode verurteilt wurden, mussten um ihr Leben wurfeln. Der Gewinner wurde frei, der Verlierer an Ort und Stelle gehenkt.Das Blutgericht am Haushamer Feld ging als das grausame Frankenburger Wurfelspiel in die Geschichte ein und gilt als Auftakt zum oberosterreichischen Bauernkrieg. Das ERLEBNIS ÖSTERREICH des ORF Oberosterreich widmet sich diesem groSSten osterreichische Historienspiels, das zum Gedenken alle zwei Jahre als Volksstuck "Frankenburger Wurfelspiel" mit rund 700 Laienschauspielern in Frankenburg am Hausruck aufgefuhrt wird.

programme.title: At the scene / Am Schauplatz
programme.desc: It is a ritual for many Austrians: drive to Lignano once a year. The almost 7,000 inhabitant place on the upper Adriatic in Italy wakes up to 200,000 people in the summer months. However, the seaside resort was not fully booked because some traditional holidaymakers and holidaymakers are making an arch around the city this weekend. The 61-year-old describes itself as a savvy and with his wife prefers to come to the Adriatic in the pre- and off-season, and never stay for 14 days. The Salzburger Thomas, on the other hand, worked for more than 20 years in the summer season in Lignano. In the meantime, he lives there with his family and operates a pension that is also popular with Esterreichische Gasten. At the scene of Reporter Nicole Kampl, Lignano shows while Pentecost and away from Pentecost and explores the question of why so many Austrians in the seaside resort every year. / Fur viele Österreicherinnen und Österreicher ist es ein Ritual: Einmal im Jahr nach Lignano fahren. Der knapp 7.000 Einwohner Ort an der Oberen Adria in Italien wachst in den Sommermonaten auf 200.000 Menschen an. Weit mehr als die Halfte der auslandischen Gaste kommt aus Österreich. Als Saisonauftakt gilt Pfingsten: Auch heuer stromten wieder 20.000 junge Österreicher und Österreicherinnen nach Lignano Sabbiadoro, um dort mit reichlich Alkohol unter dem selbsternannten Motto "tutto gas" zu feiern. Ausgebucht war der Badeort allerdings nicht, weil manche Traditionsurlauber- und Urlauberinnen gerade an diesem Wochenende einen Bogen um die Stadt machen. Der geburtige Wiener Gerhard ist heuer bereits das 60. Jahr in Folge am Strand von Lignano Pineta. Der 61jahrige bezeichnet sich als Sparfuchs und kommt mit seiner Frau bevorzugt in der Vor- und Nachsaison an die Adria, langer als 14 Tage bleiben sie nie. Der Salzburger Thomas hingegen arbeitete mehr als 20 Jahre lang in der Sommersaison in Lignano. Mittlerweile lebt er mit seiner Familie dort und betreibt eine Pension, die auch bei osterreichischen Gasten beliebt ist. Am Schauplatz Reporterin Nicole Kampl zeigt Lignano wahrend und abseits von Pfingsten und geht der Frage nach, warum jedes Jahr so viele Österreicherinnen und Österreicher in den Badeort stromen.

programme.title: Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.sub-title: Rund um den Glockner - Von Fusch nach Heiligenblut
programme.desc: In this "land of the mountains" production, the area around the highest of all Austrians, the almost 3800 meter high Großglockner, is explored. "The giant", as it is often called, has been jewelry with the Glockner Hochalpenstrasse since August 3, 1935. What started in 1923 as a design on Franz Friedrich Wallack's desk and became one of the greatest job creation programs in the first Republic in the 1930s is one of the best -known panoramic paths in Europe in the heart of the Hohe Tauern National Park. Herbert Gschwendtner, TV Moderator and Author of many hiking bookers, leads as usual as a witty through this cinematic journey, which begins in Bruck, the kilometer 0 on Glocknerstrasse. Then it goes to the Ferleitental. Away from the hustle and bustle of the most founded high alpine roads in Austria, you can find confidant alpine huts, kilometers -long stone fence and the greatest bog in the Hohen Tauern. From Ferleiten, the Pinzgau pilgrimage, which will go to Heiligenblut over 35 kilometers and 1300 high meters once a year. What were the Hohe Tauern if you couldn't climb them? The former manager Peter Embacher runs the hiking path from the Edelweiss tip to the Baumgartlkopf to 2623 meters high. From Glocknerhaus, the National Parkranger Kathrin Fercher shows the path up to the Franz-Josefs-Hohe along the margarit reservoir, on which Empress Sissi was already hiking. The trip ends in Heiligenblut, one of the barnest communities in the Hohe Tauern and at the same time the place where many crashed alpineists found their last resting at the cemetery in Heiligenblut. There is also a memorial for the crashed down -to -the -go downhillers from the over 150 years of alpine history of the Grossglockner region. / In dieser "Land der Berge" Produktion wird die Gegend rund um den hochsten aller Österreicher, den knapp 3800 Meter hohen GroSSglockner, erkundet. "Der Gigant", wie er auch oft genannt wird, schmuckt sich seit dem 3. August 1935 mit der Glockner HochalpenstraSSe. Was 1923 als Entwurf auf dem Schreibtisch von Franz Friedrich Wallack begann und in den 1930er Jahren zu einem der groSSten Arbeitsbeschaffungsprogramme der Ersten Republik wurde, ist heute einer der bekanntesten Panoramawege Europas im Herzen des Nationalparks Hohe Tauern. Herbert Gschwendtner, TV Moderator and Autor vieler Wanderbucher, fuhrt gewohnt sachkundig wie gewitzt durch diese filmische Reise, die in Bruck beginnt, dem Kilometer 0 der GlocknerstraSSe. AnschlieSSend geht es ins Ferleitental. Weg vom Trubel der beruhmtesten hochalpinen StraSSe Österreichs, findet man vertraumte Almhutten, kilometerlange Steinzaune und das groSSte Moor in den Hohen Tauern.Von Ferleiten aus beginnt auch die Pinzgauer Wallfahrt, die uber 35 Kilometer und 1300 Hohenmeter in ca. 10 Stunden einmal im Jahr nach Heiligenblut fuhrt.Doch was waren wohl die Hohen Tauern, wenn man sie nicht auch besteigen konnte? Der ehemalige Betriebsleiter Peter Embacher fuhrt uber den Wanderpfad von der EdelweiSSspitze aus auf den Baumgartlkopf auf 2623 Meter Hohe. Von Glocknerhaus aus zeigt die Nationalparkrangerin Kathrin Fercher entlang des Margaritzenstausees den Pfad hinauf auf die Franz-Josefs-Hohe, auf dem schon Kaiserin Sissi wanderte.Die Reise endet in Heiligenblut, einer der schonsten Gemeinden in den Hohen Tauern und zugleich jener Ort, an dem viele verungluckte Alpinisten ihre letzte Ruhestatte fanden: Am Friedhof in Heiligenblut. Dort befindet sich auch eine Gedenkstatte fur die verungluckten Bergabenteurer aus der uber 150 Jahre langen Alpingeschichte der GroSSglocknerregion.

programme.desc: The Hohe Tauern National Park is the largest national park in the Alps and forms the largest protected area in Central Europe. With these nuclear explosives, the United States secured its position as a dominant nuclear power in front of the USSR. The costs for this were incredibly high. The islands of the Atolle were contaminated with plutonium and other highly radioactive isotopes. The USA began to clean the contaminated islands, but only super-flat. 80,000 cubic meters of nuclear pour were hooded in a huge bomb crater and covered with a concrete dome. The Runit Dome had disappeared from the public for decades. That is currently different. Also due to the consequences of climate change, the whole structure threatens to become unstable and radioactive material. "There is a possibility that the Runit Dome could be exposed to the sea water that radioactivity is then distributed in the Pacific Ocean," says Nelio Palmenco, who accompanies the ZDF team on site. Dentz and the Pilot Dierk Reuter get their own impression on the Atoll. You will find cracks in the concrete structure, take your own measurements. The team talks to scientists and meets former decontamination workers. The inhabitants of the Atoll fear of the future: "The world should know that there is a very worrying and dangerous thing here ... and people who live with it," says Sue Luther, the head of administration of the Atoll. / Die "planet e."-Dokumentation erzahlt eine abenteuerliche Reise zu einem der groSSten Atommullendlager der Welt, mitten im Pazifik.Tausende Kilometer sind Autor Johannes Hano und sein Team in einer kleinen einmotorigen Propellermaschine uber die endlosen Weiten des Pazifiks geflogen, um zu einem der bizarrsten Bauwerke der Gegenwart zu gelangen - dem Runit Dome auf dem Enewetak-Atoll.In den 40er- und 50er-Jahren hatten die USA auf dem Atoll, das zu den Marshallinseln gehort, Kernwaffentests durchgefuhrt und 43 Atombomben zur Explosion gebracht. Darunter die erste Wasserstoffbombe der Welt mit einer Sprengkraft fast 700-mal starker als die Hiroshima-Bombe. Mit diesen nuklearen Sprengsatzen sicherten die USA ihre Position als dominierende Atommacht vor der UdSSR. Die Kosten dafur waren unglaublich hoch. Die Inseln der Atolle wurden mit Plutonium und anderen hoch radioaktiven Isotopen kontaminiert.Ende der 70er-Jahre begannen die USA, die verseuchten Inseln zu saubern, allerdings nur oberflachlich. 80.000 Kubikmeter Atommull wurden in einen riesigen Bombenkrater geschuttet und mit einer Betonkuppel uberdeckt. Jahrzehntelang war der Runit Dome aus der Öffentlichkeit verschwunden. Das andert sich gerade. Auch bedingt durch die Folgen des Klimawandels, droht die ganze Struktur instabil zu werden und radioaktives Material zu entweichen."Es besteht die Moglichkeit, dass der Runit Dome dem Meerwasser ausgesetzt werden konnte, dass sich Radioaktivitat dann im Pazifischen Ozean verteilt" sagt Nelio Palmenco, der das ZDF-Team vor Ort begleitet.Johannes Hano, sein Kamerateam Toby Marshall und Brian Dentz sowie der Pilot Dierk Reuter verschaffen sich einen eigenen Eindruck auf dem Atoll. Sie finden Risse in der Betonstruktur, nehmen eigene Messungen vor. Das Team spricht mit Wissenschaftlern und trifft ehemalige Dekontaminierungsarbeiter. Die Bewohner des Atolls furchten sich vor der Zukunft: "Die Welt sollte wissen, dass es hier eine sehr beunruhigende und gefahrliche Sache gibt ... und Menschen, die damit leben", sagt Sue Luther, die Verwaltungschefin des Atolls.Der Runit Dome ist zu einem Symbol fur das Atomzeitalter geworden - und die unkalkulierbaren Gefahren, die es mit sich gebracht hat.

programme.title: The time machine (e) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: G. Papanikolaou. Fifty years after the death of the great scientist who discovered the Pap test, the show illuminates unknown aspects of his life and childhood in Kymi. Research presents his daily struggle and his passion for perfection. / Επεισόδιο: Γ. Παπανικολάου. Πενήντα χρόνια μετά το θάνατο του μεγάλου επιστήμονα που ανακάλυψε το τεστ Παπ, η εκπομπή φωτίζει άγνωστες πτυχές της ζωής του και τα παιδικά χρόνια στην Κύμη. Η έρευνα παρουσιάζει τον καθημερινό του αγώνα και το πάθος του για την τελειότητα.

programme.title: We arrived! K2 E20 (E) / Φτάσαμε! Κ2 Ε20 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Amorgos. On Easter Sunday, we arrived with Jerome Kalouta welcomes viewers to Amorgos of wild beauty and endless blue. / Επεισόδιο: Αμοργός. Την Κυριακή του Πάσχα, η εκπομπή Φτάσαμε με τον Ζερόμ Καλούτα καλωσορίζει τους τηλεθεατές στην Αμοργό της άγριας ομορφιάς και του απέραντου γαλάζιου.

programme.title: Mom's cake K1 E30 / Η Τούρτα της Μαμάς Κ1 Ε30
programme.desc: Episode: Marios in Love. Marios' disappearance from his school will sound alarm to all ground forces: state and family! For 5 hours the house in Petralona will be turned into a crazy search for the demonic kid! / Επεισόδιο: Μάριος In Love. Η εξαφάνιση του Μάριου από το σχολείο του θα σημάνει συναγερμό σε όλες τις επίγειες δυνάμεις: κρατικές και οικογενειακές! Για 5 ώρες το σπίτι στα Πετράλωνα θα μετατραπεί σε ένα τρελό στρατηγείο αναζήτησης του δαιμόνιου πιτσιρικά!

programme.title: Studio 4 / Στούντιο 4
programme.desc: Nancy Zambetoglou and Thanassis Anagnostopoulos continue for the third season in the renewed and even richer daily magazine themes. / H Νάνσυ Ζαμπέτογλου και ο Θανάσης Αναγνωστόπουλος, συνεχίζουν για τρίτη σεζόν στο ανανεωμένο και ακόμη πιο πλούσιο σε θεματολογία καθημερινό μαγκαζίνο.

programme.title: Connections / Συνδέσεις
programme.desc: Kostas Papachlimintzos and Katerina Doukas are linked to Greece and the world and transmit what is happening and what concerns us and affects our daily lives. / Ο Κώστας Παπαχλιμίντζος και η Κατερίνα Δούκα συνδέονται με την Ελλάδα και τον κόσμο και μεταδίδουν ό,τι συμβαίνει και ό,τι μας αφορά και επηρεάζει την καθημερινότητά μας.

programme.title: The time machine (e) / Η Μηχανή του Χρόνου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Georgia Vassiliadou. Georgia Vassiliadou, the beautiful Athens who had to change her name to make a career in the theater. The unknown life of the big comedian, as a singer of the Lyric Stage and her big, unexpected, jump on the big screen. / Επεισόδιο: Γεωργία Βασιλειάδου. Η Γεωργία Βασιλειάδου, η ωραία των Αθηνών που χρειάστηκε να αλλάξει το όνομά της για να κάνει καριέρα στο θέατρο. Η άγνωστη ζωή της μεγάλης κωμικού, ως τραγουδίστρια της Λυρικής σκηνής και το μεγάλο, αναπάντεχο, άλμα της στη μεγάλη οθόνη.

programme.title: Life otherwise K2 E2 (E) / Η Ζωή Αλλιώς Κ2 Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Corfu, the nobleman - Part B. There are some cities that you don't just see, but you feel. While the ship is approaching the port of Corfu, everyone is running on the deck to admire the beautiful view of old houses and fortresses ... / Επεισόδιο: Κέρκυρα, η Αρχόντισσα - Β Μέρος. Υπάρχουν κάποιες πόλεις που δεν τις βλέπεις απλά, αλλά τις νιώθεις. Τη στιγμή που το πλοίο πλησιάζει το λιμάνι της Κέρκυρας, όλοι τρέχουν στο κατάστρωμα για να θαυμάσουν την πανέμορφη θέα των παλιών σπιτιών και των φρουρίων...

programme.title: We arrived! K2 E21 (E) / Φτάσαμε! Κ2 Ε21 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Jia. Jerome Kaluta discovers hidden treasures in lush, generous in beautiful forests and beautiful beaches, Jia. The journey starts from Ioulida, continues in ancient Carthage and ends in the lighthouse of Ag. Nicholas. / Επεισόδιο: Τζια. Ο Ζερόμ Καλούτα ανακαλύπτει κρυμμένους θησαυρούς στην καταπράσινη, γενναιόδωρη σε υπέροχα δάση και πανέμορφες παραλίες, Τζια. Το ταξίδι ξεκινά από την Ιουλίδα, συνεχίζει στην αρχαία Καρθαία και ολοκληρώνεται στον Φάρο του Αγ. Νικολάου.

programme.title: News - Sports - Weather / Ειδήσεις - Αθλητικά - Καιρός
programme.desc: Watch the latest developments at national and international level and find out on time and objectively on the important issues of the news from the ERT news team. / Παρακολουθήστε τις τελευταίες εξελίξεις σε εθνικό αλλά και διεθνές επίπεδο και ενημερωθείτε έγκαιρα και αντικειμενικά για τα σημαντικά ζητήματα της επικαιρότητας από την ειδησεογραφική ομάδα της ΕΡΤ.

programme.title: Groom / Κορόιδο Γαμπρέ
programme.desc: Two middle -aged people, working in a tavern, fall in love with the same young girl, but their competition will prove to be in vain as the girl falls in love with a much younger man. (79) / Δύο μεσήλικοι, που δουλεύουν σε μια ταβέρνα, ερωτεύονται την ίδια νεαρή κοπέλα, αλλά ο ανταγωνισμός τους θα αποδειχθεί μάταιος, καθώς η κοπέλα ερωτεύεται έναν κατά πολύ νεότερό τους άνδρα. (79)

programme.title: Star squares (e) / Τα Τετράγωνα των Αστέρων (Ε)
programme.desc: The popular 80s game that was loved by the public returns to ERT, with Emerald Karydis. Get ready for laughter, reversals and a lot of fun. / Το δημοφιλές τηλεπαιχνίδι των 80s που αγαπήθηκε από το κοινό, επιστρέφει στην ΕΡΤ, με τη Σμαράγδα Καρύδη. Ετοιμαστείτε για γέλιο, ανατροπές και πολύ κέφι.

programme.desc: With correspondents in every corner of Greece and around the world, ERT's detailed news release brings to every home everyday reporting, extraordinary news, and what affects our lives. / Με ανταποκριτές σε κάθε γωνιά της Ελλάδας και σε όλο τον κόσμο το αναλυτικό δελτίο ειδήσεων της ΕΡΤ μεταφέρει σε κάθε σπίτι το καθημερινό ρεπορτάζ, τις έκτακτες ειδήσεις, αλλά και όσα επηρεάζουν τη ζωή μας.

programme.title: The adventures of Hercules Poirot K4 E3 (E) / Οι Περιπέτειες του Ηρακλή Πουαρό Κ4 Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Murder or suicide? After visiting the Inspector Poirot's routine to his dentist, it seems that the doctor commits suicide a little later. Police are calling for the assistance of Inspector Poirot in the double capacity of the witness and the adviser. / Επεισόδιο: Φόνος ή Αυτοκτονία; Μετά την επίσκεψη ρουτίνας του Επιθεωρητή Πουαρό στον οδοντίατρό του, φαίνεται ότι ο γιατρός αυτοκτονεί λίγο αργότερα. Η αστυνομία ζητά την αρωγή του Επιθεωρητή Πουαρό με τη διπλή ιδιότητα του μάρτυρα αλλά και του συμβούλου.

programme.title: Mom in secret E28 (e) / Μαμά στα Κρυφά Ε28 (Ε)
programme.desc: The time has come for Lisa's exams and her stress is not described. Harris stands by her preparation by causing Panos's jealousy. Mark brings to the office a good friend who needs a lawyer. / Έφτασε η ώρα για τις εξετάσεις της Λίζας και το άγχος της δεν περιγράφεται. Ο Χάρης στέκεται δίπλα της στην προετοιμασία της προκαλώντας τη ζήλια του Πάνου. Ο Μάρκος φέρνει στο γραφείο μια καλή του φίλη που χρειάζεται δικηγόρο.

programme.desc: Episode: Mauritania. In the north of Mauritania, in Zuerat, a city of miners in the mountains, Philip Gugle will travel by the only train in the country that receives passengers. Θα χαζέψει τοπία γεμάτα άμμο και θα δει πώς ζουν οι άνθρωποι της ερήμου.

programme.title: Butterflies, the superheroes of nature (e) / Πεταλούδες, οι Υπερήρωες της Φύσης (Ε)
programme.desc: Butterflies are a group of superheroes of nature. Some can fly at distances exceeding 10,000 kilometers. Others can take the form of owl. Some can even become invisible. / Οι πεταλούδες αποτελούν μια ομάδα υπερηρώων της φύσης. Ορισμένες μπορούν να πετάξουν σε αποστάσεις που ξεπερνούν τα 10.000 χιλιόμετρα. Άλλες μπορούν να πάρουν τη μορφή κουκουβάγιας. Κάποιες μπορούν ακόμη και να γίνουν αόρατες.

programme.title: A farm in Switzerland (E) / Ένα Αγρόκτημα στην Ελβετία (Ε)
programme.desc: Yar, an IT expert, radically changed his life. He bought two small cows and moved to the province. There, he founded the Lebenshof shelter, offering home to animals that would otherwise be killed. / Ο Γιόαρ, ειδικός στον τομέα της πληροφορικής, άλλαξε ριζικά τη ζωή του. Αγόρασε δύο μικρές αγελάδες και μετακόμισε στην επαρχία. Εκεί, ίδρυσε το καταφύγιο Lebenshof, που προσφέρει σπίτι σε ζώα που διαφορετικά θα θανατώνονταν.

programme.title: 24 hours Greece K5 E6 (E) / 24 Ώρες Ελλάδα Κ5 Ε6 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Argolida. In one of the oldest cities in Greece we will learn about its ancient theater, walk in its historic castle and meet one of the most important cultures. / Επεισόδιο: Αργολίδα. Σε μια από τις αρχαιότερες πόλεις της Ελλάδας θα μάθουμε για το αρχαίο της θέατρο, θα περπατήσουμε στο ιστορικό κάστρο της και θα γνωρίσουμε έναν από τους πιο σημαντικούς πολιτισμούς.

programme.title: Co-human E4 (e) / Συν-Άνθρωποι Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Cry Fish. Theodoris Tsimbidis and Anastasia Miliou, the two founders of the Maritime Protection Institute of Archipelago who have devoted their lives to sea protection, talk about the highly worrying results of their studies. / Επεισόδιο: Κραυγή Ιχθύος. Ο Θοδωρής Τσιμπίδης και η Αναστασία Μήλιου, οι δύο ιδρυτές του Ινστιτούτου Θαλάσσιας Προστασίας Αρχιπέλαγος που έχουν αφιερώσει την ζωή τους στην προστασία της Θάλασσας, μιλούν για τα άκρως ανησυχητικά αποτελέσματα των μελετών τους.

programme.title: Therapeutic Gardens E8 (E) / Θεραπευτικοί Κήποι Ε8 (Ε)
programme.desc: In 1995, Alexander Rapford took over the management of the Garden Rapord, who has been in his family for four generations. Alexander sees a shift in integrating nature into people's lives. / Το 1995, ο Αλεξάντερ Ρίφορντ ανέλαβε τη διεύθυνση των κήπων Ρίφορντ που ανήκε στην οικογένειά του εδώ και τέσσερις γενιές. Ο Αλεξάντερ βλέπει μια στροφή στην ενσωμάτωση της φύσης στη ζωή των ανθρώπων.

programme.title: Save our forests E2 (e) / Σώστε τα Δάση μας Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Battle against industry. Rindingers live in northern Finland since the end of the glacier era and use the forests to feed them and their animals. However, the land is not their property. / Επεισόδιο: Μάχη Ενάντια στη Βιομηχανία. Οι εκτροφείς ταράνδων ζουν στη βόρεια Φινλανδία από το τέλος της Εποχής των Παγετώνων και χρησιμοποιούν τα δάση, για να έχουν τροφή για τους ίδιους και τα ζώα τους. Ωστόσο, η γη δεν είναι ιδιοκτησία τους.

programme.title: From the field to the shelf K2 E4 (E) / Από το Χωράφι στο Ράφι Κ2 Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: buffalo. programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: The Best of / Košarka - Euroleague: The Best of
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Manchester United - Rangers / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Manchester United - Rangers
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

The name of the League was from 1959. until 2000. was the European Champion Cup after which followed the change in today's name. French club Paris Volley was the first champion under the new name of the 2001 competition. Years. / Prvog pobednika ovog takmičenja smo dobili 1960. godine nakon što je ekipa CSKA Moskve pobedila ekipu Rapida iz Bukurešta. Ruska ekipa je ujedno i najuspešnija u Ligi šampiona te jedina koja ima dvocifreni broj titula iako sve njene titule datiraju iz doba SSSRa. Sami klub je rasformiran 2009. godine iako imaju čak 13 titula prvaka Evrope. Naziv lige je od 1959. do 2000. godine bio Evropski Kup Prvaka nakon čega je sledila izmena u današnji naziv. Francuski klub Pariz Volej je bio prvi prvak pod novim nazivom takmičenja 2001. godine.

programme.title: Volleyball - Turkish League (M): Galatasaray - Ziraat / Odbojka - Turska liga (m): Galatasaray - Ziraat
programme.desc: The first Turkish volleyball league or Epher League is the highest ranking of Turkish club volleyball competition. It was founded in 1970. under the interference of the Turkish Volleyball Alliance and in today's league format contains 12 clubs. The Turkish League is considered one of the best leagues of Europe whose clubs achieve great successes in continental competitions. The historical most successful club is an approximate club with 12 conquered titles of Turkey's champion while the Halkbank follows them with eight titles. / Prva turska odbojkaška liga ili Efeler liga je najviši rang takmičenja turske klupske odbojke. Osnovana je 1970. godine pod ingerencijom Turskog odbojkaškog saveza i u današnjem formatu liga sadrži 12 klubova. Turska liga smatra se jednom od najboljih liga Evrope čiji klubovi ostvaruju velike uspehe na kontinentalnim takmičenjima. Istorijsko najuspešniji klub je Ečasibaši sa 12 osvojenih titula prvaka Turske dok ih u stopu prati Halkbank sa osam titula.

programme.title: Handball - Germany League: Fuchse Berlin - Melsungen / Rukomet - Nemačka liga: Fuchse Berlin - Melsungen
programme.desc: Handball Bundesliga is the highest rank of handball competitions in Germany. In addition to the Spanish League, the Bundesliga is considered the best European league. It was founded in 1965. as a separate competition of northern and southern regions. Only since 1977. acts as a unique competition. Currently counts 19 teams in the two-circular competition system. The most won titles are counted by the Kil Handball Club. High quality handball games and filled forums are the reason why Bundesliga is so accompanied all over the world. / Rukometna Bundesliga je najviši rang rukometnih takmičenja u Nemačkoj. Uz špansku ligu Bundesliga se smatra najboljom evropskom ligom. Osnovana je 1965. godine kao odvojeno takmičenje severne i južne regije. Tek od 1977. deluje kao jedinstveno takmičenje. Trenutno broji 19 ekipa u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Najviše osvojenih titula broji rukometni klub Kil. Visok kvalitet rukometne igre i ispunjene tribine razlog su zašto je Bundesliga toliko praćena u celom svetu.

programme.title: Dynasty / Dinastija
programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. The Black KRYSTLE family accepts cold, and the staff also look at it, and Black's stubborn and promiscuous daughter resent her. Although he is committed to Krystle, Blake devotes a lot more time and attention to his company Denver-Carrington, so he doesn't even notice what Krystle is facing. Her only ally is Black's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views. / Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Blakova družina Krystle sprejme hladno, tudi osebje nanjo gleda zviška, Blakova trmasta in promiskuitetna hči pa ji zameri. Čeprav je predan Krystle, Blake veliko več časa in pozornosti namenja svojemu podjetju Denver-Carrington, zato niti ne opazi, s čim vse se Krystle sooča. Njen edini zaveznik je Blakov sin, Steven, ki pa se z očetom, zaradi različnih političnih pogledov, ne razume najbolje.

programme.title: Librarian / Knjižničarka
programme.desc: A librarian who has lost her job and is suicidal decides on the last wonderful trip to Costa Rica before swallowing a bottle of tablets. There, she meets a younger man, a lively tourist guide who takes her to all beautiful places, and is impressed by her remote intellectualism. She is found to accept the motto of Costa Rica, "Pura Vida", which means "pure life, but in a broader sense covers national enthusiasm for life. She encourages him to read his first book, and he is to relax and have fun for the first time. An unusual but beautiful romantic relationship develops. / Knjižničarka, ki je izgubila službo in je samomorilna, se odloči za zadnje čudovito potovanje na Kostariko, preden pogoltne stekleničko tablet. Tam pa spozna mlajšega moškega, živahnega turističnega vodiča, ki jo popelje na vse čudovite kraje, in ga navdušuje njen odmaknjen intelektualizem.Trudi se, da bi sprejela moto Kostarike, "Pura Vida", kar pomeni "čisto življenje", a v širšem smislu zajema narodno navdušenje nad življenjem. Ona ga spodbudi, da prebere svojo prvo knjigo, on pa njo, da se prvič do dolgem času sprosti in zabava. Razvije se nenavadna, a lepa romantična zveza.

programme.title: Football (M): Lugano - Celje, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Lugano - Celje, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026
programme.desc: In the first match of the penultimate round of qualifying for the conference league, the Celje people are waiting for an old acquaintance, Swiss Lugano. Last year, the counts in elimination struggles were more successful in this time. In 2021, football enthusiasts will enjoy the European Conference League organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Celjane na prvi tekmi predzadnjega kroga kvalifikacij za konferenčno ligo čaka stari znanec, švicarski Lugano. Lani so bili grofje v izločilnih bojih uspešnejši, kako bo tokrat.Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Celje, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Lugano - Celje, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Lugano - Celje, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026
programme.desc: In the first match of the penultimate round of qualifying for the conference league, the Celje people are waiting for an old acquaintance, Swiss Lugano. Last year, the counts in elimination struggles were more successful in this time. In 2021, football enthusiasts will enjoy the European Conference League organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Celjane na prvi tekmi predzadnjega kroga kvalifikacij za konferenčno ligo čaka stari znanec, švicarski Lugano. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. programme.title: Drop in Gorizia, documentary, Mon. / Padec Gorice, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Pečenko Valentin... Film je posvečen spominu na enega najpomembnejših dogodkov prve svetovne vojne – padcu Gorice 1916.
programme.desc: The documentary is designed as a mosaic narrative in which Slovenian and Italian historians and history examiners dr. Branko Marušič, Ph.D. Renato Podbersic, Lucio Fabi, prof. Mario Issnenghi, Marco Mantini, Mitja Močnik and Andrea Bellawa remove the stunning image of the besieged, demolished and starved Gorizia in 1 World War. Despite the terrible Italian artillery firing in it, a considerable part of the population insisted from the summer of 1915 to 9. August 1916, when the Italians rode into a ruined city and proclaimed the victory in the 6th Battle of Soča. The defenders had to retreat to the left bank of the Soča River, before which they demolished its bridges. The myth of invincible Austro-Hungarian defenders fell. For the Slovenes, the occupation of Gorizia meant the loss of a centuries -old cultural and economic center, where they stayed with the Italians, Friulians, Germans and other nations of the Habsburg monarchy. The majority of archival film footage was contributed by the Friuli Cinematheque (La Cineteca del Friuli). / Dokumentarec je zasnovan kot mozaična pripoved, v kateri slovenski in italijanski zgodovinarji ter preučevalci zgodovine dr. Branko Marušič, dr. Renato Podbersič, Lucio Fabi, prof. Mario Isnenghi, Marco Mantini, Mitja Močnik in Andrea Bellavite odstirajo osupljivo podobo oblegane, porušene in sestradane Gorice v 1. svetovni vojni. Precejšen del prebivalstva je kljub strahotnemu italijanskemu topniškemu obstreljevanju v njej vztrajal od poletja 1915 do 9. avgusta 1916, ko so Italijani pompozno vkorakali v razdejano mesto in oznanjali zmago v 6. soški bitki. Branilci so se morali umakniti na levi breg reke Soče, pred tem pa so porušili njene mostove. Mit o nepremagljivih avstro-ogrskih branilcih je padel. Za Slovence pa je zasedba Gorice pomenila izgubo večstoletnega kulturnega in gospodarskega središča, v katerem so bivali skupaj z Italijani, Furlani, Nemci in drugimi narodi habsburške monarhije.Dokumentarni film, katerega režiser in scenarist je Valentin Pečenko, je nastal v sodelovanju s številnimi inštitucijami, društvi in zbiralci iz Slovenije in Italije, iz Gorice in Nove Gorice, glavnino arhivskih filmskih posnetkov pa je prispevala Kinoteka Furlanije (La Cineteca del Friuli).
